subject: Initial discovery / demo scheduling — Nimbus Analytics
message_1_subject: Intro & request for demo — Nimbus Analytics
message_1_body:
Hi Rishi,

Quick intro — I’m Maya, Product Manager at Nimbus Analytics. We’re investigating inference platforms to replace a self-managed GPU fleet and would like a short discovery/demo to understand Redwood’s latency/cost profile and deployment options (hosted vs private).

Suggested attendees from our side: Carlos Duarte (Engineering Lead), an attendee from Procurement (procurement@nimbus.ai), and one person from security (sec_ops@nimbus.ai) if possible. We’re mostly interested in:
- high-level architecture and security controls
- performance at 512–2048 token contexts
- cost/benchmark assumptions and deployment options

Are you available for a 30–45m call the week of June 1? We prefer mornings PST (June 1–3).

Thanks — happy to coordinate calendar slots.

— Maya
Maya Singh
Product Manager | Nimbus Analytics
maya.singh@nimbus.ai
message_2_subject: Re: Intro & request for demo — Nimbus Analytics
message_2_body:
Hi Maya — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the context.

Happy to run a discovery and demo with the right folks. From Redwood we’d have me (AE) + Soojin Lee (Solutions Engineer) — Soojin will cover architecture and security controls. Dev Patel is available as backup for deeper infra questions.

I’m available for 30–45m at these PST times:
- Tue, Jun 1: 10:00–10:45am PT
- Wed, Jun 2: 9:00–9:45am PT
- Thu, Jun 3: 1:00–1:45pm PT

If any of those work please confirm the final attendee list (especially security/procurement) and whether recording is ok. I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and attach a mutual action plan (MAP) for the procurement track.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/rishi-redwood/initial-discovery-30m

Attaching: MMP-Nimbus-Analytics-2026-05.pdf (mutual action plan stub)

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
message_3_subject: Re: Intro & request for demo — Nimbus Analytics
message_3_body:
Thanks Rishi — Jun 1/10am PT would have worked but Procurement just flagged a calendar conflict and asked if we can move to Jun 2 at 9am PT instead.

Security would like to join but may be ~10–15m late; they also asked in advance for SOC2 scope and any runbooks you can share during the call. Recording is fine.

Final attendee list likely:
- Maya Singh (Product)
- Carlos Duarte (Eng Lead)
- Procurement (procurement@nimbus.ai) — may only join the tail end
- Security (sec_ops) — may be late

Can you send an updated invite for Wed, Jun 2 at 9:00am PT?

— Maya
message_4_subject: Re: Intro & request for demo — Nimbus Analytics
message_4_body:
Thanks Maya — can do Wed 6/2 9am PT. I’ll cover architecture, deployment options (hosted, dedicated, private) and security controls (KMS/HSM, VPC/private deployment, audit logs).

I’ve attached a high-level architecture diagram that I can walk through during the call. For SOC2 evidence, we can point you to our SOC2 summary and change log — happy to share the SOC2 package after an NDA if required.

Attachment: redwood-arch-diagram.png

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
message_5_subject: Updated invite & agenda — Redwood x Nimbus discovery (Wed, Jun 2 @ 9:00am PT)
message_5_body:
Hi all — thanks for the flexibility. Calendar invite sent for Wed, Jun 2 at 9:00am PT (30m).

Agenda (30m):
- 0—5m: Introductions + goals (Maya/Carlos)
- 5–20m: Demo + architecture walk (Soojin)
- 20–25m: Deployment options & security/controls (Soojin)
